historicalAssets: Existing videos and non-English references are not overwritten

scoring.content: Real taps change the score through 30–30, 40–30, Deuce, Advantage and Deuce again; heart-rate value is a synthetic demo reading

watch.processing: H.264 web compression and extracted posters. UI pixels are not retouched. Original MatchFlap.wav application sound is synchronized to recorded action timestamps at the app's 0.30 gain; the simulator recorder itself does not capture audio. Original takes and action logs are retained in task artifacts.

watchFaces.status: Not used on the website. Original complication_accessory_corner.webp and complication_accessory_circular.webp restored at the user's request; no further face changes requested.

watchFaces.circular: Meridian with the actual Tennis Score Wizard Pro accessoryCircular widget in its left slot
watchFaces.processing: Real full-face simulator captures, resized/compressed as WebP only. System rendering controls each face's widget tint. No application code changed.
